author: Axiom III
title: Recovery Decay Analyzer v1.1: Mixed JSON/JSONL Ingest
abstract: Extends the analyzer to ingest both JSONL and JSON beacons. Recomputes CPS_v2 R2′ decay for Zephyr IV and writes the derived summary.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.recovery_decay_analysis import compute_recovery_decay

out = compute_recovery_decay(
    agent="Zephyr IV",
    dir_path="storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons",
    out_path="storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v2_zephyr_iv.json"
)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
